reviews.title: Good idea, badly executed
reviews.text:
Ok, I'm going to give an honest review of this app:

Pros 

- challenges and pet are fun, good for keeping you motivated and engaged with the process
- it's easy to use and relatively intuitive
- the interface is aesthetically pleasing
- you can set your own goals, including calories, macros and fibre
- easy to add your own recipes for quick logging
- good integration with Apple health 

Cons

- the food library defaults to the 100g serving on the nutritional label rather than recommended or common servings (ie. 1 biscuit) - it is entirely dependent on users adding this to build the library, which can make it time consuming
- the lessons on the paid option are basic, confusing and badly structured - if you're after a nutritional education, Noom and Second Nature are much better, needs improvement as it's not really providing the information you need to succeed.
- If you choose to add or update the nutritional library, please beware. I've noticed it continues to use my camera even when it's no longer necessary and I have to restart the app to stop it. This is a serious security concern. 
- some really questionable ai recommendations and swaps

reviews.title: Tracking food is clunky and time-consuming. App deleted.
reviews.text:
This app offered so much. I had hoped it would motivate me to track my calories with the little avocado pet and that the AI aspect would make that easy. I even paid for it because my hopes were so high. But it failed on both counts. The main problem was that the nutritional information was often wrong, with the correct food hard to find. Even when taking photos with AI (which I often forgot to do before eating), I constantly needed to correct everything and verify the information against another app (Nutracheck). Logging my food was so time-consuming and boring, I often didn’t bother.

As for the motivational aspect, I didn’t find the little avocado to be enough of an incentive. I already use Finch, which has a similar concept in terms of a virtual pet that you can get clothes and home furnishings for when you complete tasks. But the Finch graphics are much better, the pet much cuter, and what you can get with your credits is more attractive. The avocado did nothing to make me want to log my food or do daily lessons.

So though I have a paid subscription for the whole year, I’ve now deleted the app. It’s not worth the energy and I’d prefer to use an app that doesn’t make calorie counting so time-consuming.

reviews.title: Not as smart as they claim
reviews.text:
I lost weight steadily for a while. A pound a week easily. Then after losing 10 pounds, I hit a brick wall and have been stuck here for over a month.

The app never re-calculates your calorie goal once your weight changes. Even when I manually hit the “Recalculate” button myself, it just shows me the same number. So how do I trust an app that’s not even smart enough to recognize that calorie goals change as weight changes?

reviews.title: Runs out of content fast
reviews.text:
At first I used to really like this app cause it helped me keep track of everything in one place (meals, water, weight, training) but I also found the short courses quite informative. Too bad after few weeks you just get fed the same questions and «challenges» over and over. The whole seed game also seems quite pointless, don’t see the reason behind it. 
Since I paid for a year subscription I’m gonna keep using it to track my daily routines until it runs out, I’m not gonna renew this. 

It’s sad cause there is so much to learn about nutritions and health and supplements I would have preferred they’d invested into keeping the courses content more interesting instead of giving me a silly game. 
 
On a positive note, it made me realise if I wanted to invest money into my health I needed a real-life coach, and I’ve since lost tons of weight and bettered my life. I never expected an app to do that, but I would have definitely kept the subscription if it would have fed me more actual knowledge instead of asking me to feed a seed while «challenging» me every other day to walk 30min or read a book before bed 🙂‍↕️

reviews.title: J’ai quitté YAZIO pour les mêmes raisons
reviews.text:
Bravo pour la fonction de prise en photo des plats et surtout de la possibilité de modifier pour notamment ajuster les quantités de chaque élément d’une assiette. Par contre la quantité de protéines est sur-évaluée et souvent le poids de l'assiette est trop important. Je passe 5 minutes chaque fois à évaluer et modifier le poids de chaque ingrédient. 
Les couleurs d'aliments sont différentes d'une entrée à l'autre. Pourquoi le pain aux graines de telle enseigne/boulangerie est il noté vert et un autre noté orange alors que la quantité de lipide est moindre et celle des glucides aussi? Il faudrait faire également la différence dans la quantité de glucides d'un repas entre les féculents, les sucres rapides et les sucres des fruits. Et puis, pardon, la graine qui grandit et le coffre à ouvrir régulièrement, il n'y a pas que des accros aux jeux vidéos qui utilisent votre application. En fait à en juger par les commentaires, ce serait plutôt le contraire. Obligée de ´kill’  l’application après l’enregistrement du premier repas de certains jours  afin d’éviter toute cette perte de temps et de l’ouvrir à nouveau. 
Au moins ajoutez une option pour sauter tout cela! Quel gaspillage de temps🤦‍♀️

reviews.title: Insanely stupid
reviews.text: I don’t love AI, but my dislike is more towards generative AI than others, so I tried this. I’ve been on the app for like ten minutes. It’s not good. First of all, it allows people as young as NINE to use their app (presumably, as that’s how low they’ll let you scroll when inserting your age). I’ve done calorie deficits before (I’m fifteen) and most apps I’ve found don’t let you even sign up if you put your age as under eighteen, due to it being inadvisable for children to focus on weight loss. I’m only attempting after getting the advice of a doctor. Second of all, while filling out my information, it told me I would be losing about 11 pounds a month. That’s roughly .4 pounds a DAY, which is an unhealthy rate to lose weight. Third of all, it gave me very much eating disorder vibes. That’s just unpleasant. And fourth of all, when I finally got into the app, it recommended I eat 2452 calories a day. I’m 5’3, do a milder sport, and am trying to lose about 20 pounds. In no world would that much food help me lose weight. I don’t even think I eat that much now, nor could I if I really tried.

reviews.title: Charged Immediately - No Free Trial?
reviews.text:
★★☆☆☆

I subscribed believing I was signing up for a free trial, but instead I was charged immediately. It left me feeling disappointed from the outset.

After briefly using the app, I found that it simply wasn’t suitable for my needs and the interface is not as user friendly as other apps I have looked at.

I barely used the service before deciding it wasn’t for me. Apple have declined to refund. Unfortunately, because the subscription was purchased through Apple, Foodvisor advised that they are unable to assist with a refund and referred me back to Apple.

I don’t feel it offers good value for UK users as as others have noted you sign up for the premium service to find that there are features not available to you and you have to pay further to access these.

 I would encourage clearer communication around subscriptions and free trials to help prevent other customers making the same mistake.

reviews.title: Avoid this app! It’s a ripoff - nearly £70 for 3 months, and impossible to cancel after your trial
reviews.text:
Avoid this app, it’s a ripoff and impossible to cancel after your free trial ends. 

I did the trial, was happy with the app and was going to subscribe, my wife uses it and pays £19.99 per year. After 14 days I received a bill for nearly £70, for a 3 month subscription! No option to choose a subscription plan, no option to cancel, and the app doesn’t show in my Apple subscriptions, so I literally had no option to cancel, or even amend my plan. 

I emailed the company, provided full details and images, and that I was happy to continue on the same plan as my wife. They refused to refund, or even part refund and amend my plan. 

I wouldn’t go anywhere near this app.

reviews.title: Misleading subscription information
reviews.text: Downloaded the app and was offered a 12 month subscription for £1.66 per month equating to £19.99 for the year. I thought £1.66 per month was reasonable so I hit subscribe only to find the full years subscription was taken. This is deceptive as it also states you can cancel anytime, giving the impression again that it is a monthly agreement. I believe it is worded this way purposely to get people to subscribe. After looking through other reviews it seems I’m not the only one who was conned this way. Also it isn’t until they take your money that you realise the premium subscription isn’t so premium after all, as you can’t access the unlimited exercises they promise without paying even more. It clearly states in the write on the App Store that premium includes unlimited exercises. This is not true and is false advertising. I have asked Apple for a refund. *UPDATE* I have been refunded on the right to withdraw and will now delete this app.

reviews.title: Speed running to an eating disorder
reviews.text: First and foremost, the UI is cute and friendlier than other tracking apps. However, it also grades you on essentially everything you log with a green smiling face for good and red sad faces for bad. Tracking calories can already be difficult for some but getting “graded” on essentially everything you consume feels like it can be extremely harmful and contributing to more guilt compared to other calorie tracking apps. You could literally be doing great and fulfilling a calorie deficit but still poorly graded. Not to mention that it doesn’t have as wide of variety of foods that you’re able to log compared to other apps. I get it for people who want that information but for others this could be really harmful. Not to mention the insane subscription price and difficult subscription cancelling process. You have to click through the app and confirm multiple times that yes, you want to cancel only for it to open your system setting and it does nothing. You have to cancel in the App Store itself. Save your money and mental health and use something else.

reviews.text:
I appreciate the visuals and the features but I wish you could turn off the pop ups in app, they’re as bad as ads for blocking me logging anything in the app, not ADHD friendly. Additionally they use ‘good’ and ‘bad’ food narratives which I’ve tried so hard to move away from and I find damaging to my motivation and mental health journey generally. Would be great to be able to turn that feature off for those (probably a large portion of the user group) users that find it detrimental. 

Additionally the contact us button doesn’t work, I’d love to address this with the team so I can make fixes before my years subscription is up so it isn’t wasted and may help other users

reviews.title: Over charged
reviews.text: The app itself looks great and easy to navigate. Like something you can actually use and get results. HOWEVER the subscription page comes up with the premium content prices. I am giving the one star rating as the annual subscription is shown with a monthly payment price. I agreed to pay £2:99 per month, with the right to cancel at any time. BUT I was charged for the full year of £35:99. That makes me untrusting of the app. I will not be using it.

reviews.title: Writing a review to get customer service’s attention
reviews.text:
I’ve tried several times to reach out via the app, but the Contact Us bot is pathetic, and no one’s answering my contact forms. 

The barcode reader isn’t always accurate. In fact, it’s often not. There’s an option to report an issue and correct the nutritional facts logged, but it just circles you around to add the food to your journal again, rather than actually correcting anything. After paying for this subscription, I expect for it to work correctly, and I definitely expect to be able to accurately track calories and other macros. 

Right now, I can’t recommend the app, as it’s buggy and the developers aren’t responding to customers. Too bad.

reviews.title: Back to My Fitness Pal for me
reviews.text:
I thought I’d try a different food logging app but regret spending the £20 If I am honest. I used it for a few weeks but it constantly harasses you to maintain streaks and earn gems. I had a few days off and didn’t mind losing the streak, what I did mind though, was losing all of my frequently used foods which made it easy to log my day. No reply from Customer Services, either. 
I have returned to My Fitness Pal, from which I have had a long break, and all of my data is still there, making it easy to dip in and out. I won’t use Foodvisor again- what a waste of time.
The reply from the app developer was sorry not sorry/ passive aggressive as well as well, as if it should have been obvious that I’d lose all of my data of I broke the streak. If you want to held captive with streaks ala Snap Chat, this is your app- but it’s not a healthy way to carry on, smart phone wise.

reviews.title: Annoying Gamification
reviews.text: I find the gamification of this app so annoying and in fact it makes me use it less. Why do we have quests, why do we have to play games just to log our diet, why do we have a streak on how many days we have logged or not ?!!! We have already paid for the app, it’s so frustrating that they made it this way. I’m a healthy adult who wants to have a Birds Eye view over my intake. THAT IS ALL !! But this seems to be for people with eating disorders. Can we just have an app that isn’t gamified or isn’t trying to obviously influence my habits or behaviours ?!!! I certainly will not be renewing.

reviews.title: Do not waste your money
reviews.text:
“0” STARS!!!
In two days I gained 2 kilograms with this miraculous calories counting. The offer was 1,65£/month, they took all the amount for a year, I wrote an email to customer service, no reply, I wrote to apple, they say “not elegibile for refund” even that say that in 14 days are giving you the money back….LIES! Don’t waste your money, the app is not calculating the proper amount of calories and you’re going to gain not to lose…I don’t know how there are so many good feedbacks but for me it’s a “heavier” frustration.

reviews.title: A bit of a con.
reviews.text:
When you set up your profile it asks you to specify you have any dietary restrictions. I said I am a vegetarian with a fish allergy. The next day it recommended a Tuna dish to me.
Also the app gives the impression it includes fitness exercises, but unbelievably this is not included in Premium - you have to buy a second package to get it.
The photographing food aspect quite often requires a lot of checking and editing as (for example) it thinks a portion of Flora margarine is 200grams.

reviews.title: $90+ App - Misleading “Free Trial” That Isn’t Free
reviews.text:
Read Before Downloading!
Don’t get scammed!!

RESPONSE: you want more specific details?! Are you kidding me! You have entire email chains with ALL of the details, weeks of run around, and from AI bots to human advisor after advisor saying there’s nothing you can do. All in UNDER 14 days of paying for a year of the app! If you want to solve it, start there. And as to suggestion that’s “it’s my feelings” that the process is difficult, then I suggest anyone look up the access to cancel PRIOR to purchase. Turns those “feelings” into facts real quick.
…

Foodvisor advertises a free 14 day “trial” depending on where you find their promotion. What they don’t tell you upfront: you are charged $90 for the full year the moment you sign up, before your “trial” even begins.

Canceling is deliberately buried in the app, making it nearly impossible to find and you can’t “cancel” you have to email, request to cancel, wait and then be directed to Apple, because you bought it in the App Store. 

And because the purchase is processed through the App Store, Apple is not obligated to issue refunds… so that $90 is gone, no matter what Foodvisor advertises.

There is no “free trial.” There is a paid subscription. Period. 

I paid the $83 app, and a $30 add on, and while the add-on refund denial makes sense, I only had it for about a week before requesting to cancel. Not an option. 

On top of that, every feature this app offers can be replicated for free with any FREE AI assistant. There is nothin

reviews.title: BEWARE before purchase
reviews.text:
I have several issues with this app. First, I wish I read the other 1 star reviews before trusting their “free” trial. When signing up for the trial, it tells you that you need to pay for the year up front and then if you are unhappy with the product you can submit for a refund through Apple… well, I was unhappy and I submitted for a refund through Apple on the FIRST possible day (you need to wait until the payment is processed until you can submit for a refund). And it was denied. When I tried to contact support through the app directly, I was given a chat box to bring me right back to the Apple page. 

Secondly, the reason I wanted a refund in the first place, is that the “premium” features are very minimally different than the non-paid features. Additionally, the “AI” tracker is often incorrect, and even when correct (or manually corrected) it severely underestimates the calorie counts.

reviews.title: Turhia ominaisuuksia liikaa
reviews.text:
Toimiva sovellus kaloreiden seurantaan. Kuvantunnistus toimii 95% tapauksissa oikein vaikkakin sillä on ongelmia hahmottaa pienten allle 100g annosten koko oikein esim. perunoiden kohdalla.

Sovelluksen pelillistäminen avatar hahmolla ja timattien keruulla häiritsee. Hahmolla ei tietenkään ole mitään telemistä laihduttamisen kanssa vaan lisätty sovellukseen ruutuakan kasvattamista varten.

Lisäksi sovellus on alkanut hidastelemaan merkittävästi pidemmän käytön jälkeen, minkä sovelluksen uudelleen asentaminen ja kerätym datan poistaminen toimi. Hidastelu alkoi avatar hahmon ilmestyessä sovellukseen.. Kehittäjät eivät vastaa mihinkään heille lähetettyyn palautteeseen muualla kuin täällä sovelluskaupassa 😂

reviews.title: käyttö
reviews.text: Ärsyttävää kun ensin käytät 15 minuuttia vastataksesi kysymyksiin ja vasta sen jälkeen ilmoitetaan että appia ei pysty käyttämään ilman maksua

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: Absolutely useless. Filled with nonsense advice. It is fun to take pictures but you still have to know the amount. It will scold you for eating one of something and laut you for eating two handfuls of nuts!

reviews.title: The bar code scanner stopped working
reviews.text: The barcode scanner doesn’t work anymore

reviews.title: Käytä varoen
reviews.text:
Sovellus antaa terveydelle vaarallisia ohjeita etenkin, kun valinta ”Sisällytä aktiivisuus tavoitteeseen” on päällä.

Tällöin sovellus laskee aktiivisuuteen kuluneen kaloritarpeen makrojakauman vastaavasti, kuin koko päivän perusmakrojakauman. Seurauksena on se, että sovellus suosittelee terveydelle vaarallisia määriä proteiinia. Esimerkiksi tänään tavoitteenani oli lähes 4 grammaa per painokilo. Tällainen määrä proteiinia kuormittaa etenkin maksaa ja munuaisia.

Tilanne korjautuisi sillä, että ylimääräistä energiakulutusta suositeltaisiin korjattavan lähes yksinomaa hiilihydraateilla ja vähäisissä määrin myös rasvalla, kuten nykyiset ravintosuositukset ohjeistavat. 

Toivoisin myös, että tämä timanttien keruu ja jonkin ihme kasvin kasvattaminen olisi kytkettävissä pois päältä. Ainakaan minua tällainen turha pelillistäminen ei motivoi ollenkaan. 

Ateriat ovat sovelluksessa aina jaettuna neljään ”aamupala”, ”lounas”, ”illallinen” ja ”välipala”. Toivoisin, että sovellukseen tulisi mahdollisuus muokata näitä ja lisätä esimerkiksi ylimääräisiä ”välipala” kohtia.

Aterioiden laatu arvostellaan sovelluksessa hymiöillä, joiden kriteerien olen kokenut epäkoherenteiksi. Viisi kananmunaa saa muikean hymynaaman, rasvaton proteiinirahka surullisen naaman. Molemmilla voi tyydyttää proteiinitarpeensa, kananmunilla saa lisäksi todennäköisesti kolesterolinsa korkeaksi.   

Pääsääntöisesti sovellus on helppokäyttöinen ja ruokien lisääminen tuntuu varsin intuitiiviselta.

Käytettävyydestä sii

reviews.title: Clunky and contradictory
reviews.text:
For the most part it’s fairly easy to use but the advice it gives contradicts itself. It tells me, egg whites are “ok😐” but then suggests switching whole eggs which are “good😊” to egg whites. Why??? 
Inputting recipes is very clunky, and impossible to do as you cook, especially for meal prep. It’s easier to weight out everything, write it down elsewhere, cook, count out portions and then input it. If you adjust the serving size, it throws all the measurements out of whack, and you have to redo everything. 
I also don’t like when you are adding a singular food to a meal, it shows you how much macros out of that whole meal without accounting for anything else you’ve added to that meal. I want to know if what I’m adding is going to help me complete my protein goal, not that it’s just 10% of my goal.

reviews.title: AI slop content, inaccurate counting calories
reviews.text:
Courses are prime chat gpt garbage. Finnish translation is extremely bad, incomprehensible in places. 

Photo recognition of foods is poor as well as judging the amounts. Basically app tells you to fille plate so that the app’s default guess is close enough. 

Sometimes corrected meal content is 100% more than the guess. Macro content of scanned foods can be completely wrong. 

”Courses” get repetitive within days and don’t adapt to your personal challenges. 

Reducing extra faff from the app could make the core functionality better. Would not buy again.

reviews.title: Lopetti toiminnan
reviews.text: Sovellus ei toimi enää päivityksen jälkeen. Ei käynnisty ja ilmoittaa kestävän tavallista kauemmin. Puolen tunnin odotuksen jälkeen ei käynnisty edelleenkään. Poistin ja asensin uudelleen. Ei toimi.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I am a bit gutted that I’ve ended up paying a year up front for this app. I thought I was purchasing a monthly subscription but the whole year came out in the transition. I have used calorie counting apps in the past which are much more intuitive than this one. I wanted to give this one a try but now I’ve paid for a year, I’m going to have to stick it out.

When you are adding weights of your food you have to scroll to get to the number. Why would I want to scroll for ages to 900 when I could type 3 digits. That’s very frustrating when you want to quickly log an item. 

Also the app tells me I’ve over eaten for the whole day when I might have only over eaten for one meal and am still under calories on the rest of my meals. It shouldn’t say that unless you have no calories left for the day.

I have 150 calories in my snack pot. When I am at 100 calories for snacks it tells me to stop snacking.

I don’t like that it uses the term bad food. Obviously some foods are worse than others but I feel criminalised for eating a 90 calorie brunch bar 🙄

Stick to nutra check

reviews.title: Useless app
reviews.text: Cannot be used. Accepting license terms and privacy policy does not work and app does not open.

reviews.title: Don’t waste your money on this
reviews.text:
This app does not work as it should. The calorie estimates based on photos are too often wildly inaccurate — in the worst case, the app’s estimate was double the actual calories of the meal. (I measured the ingredients with a kitchen scale and verified the correct values from the food packaging.) Don’t waste your money on this, the app doesn’t do what it promises!

Update after the response: The only assistance I would have needed is a refund, but already have asked that and it was impossible. Even though the app didn’t do at all what it was supposed to do. Again, don’t waste yout money on this!

reviews.title: Mahdoton peruuttaa vahingossa tehtyä tilausta!
reviews.text: Olen yrittänyt ohjeiden mukaan peruuttaa tilausta, jonka vahingossa tein. Luulin ostavani tilauksen, jossa on ilmainen kokeilujakso, mutta minulta veloitettiin tililtä koko summa. Yritin heti perua tilauksen, mutta se on nyt voimassa vuoden. Yritin laittaa tukeen pyynnön hyvityksestä, mutta se hylättiin ilman syytä. Myöskään asiakaspalvelu ei vastaa (sähköposti, johon pyydettiin olemaan yhteydessä) ja automaattivastaus jonka toisella kertaa sain, neuvoo tekemään samaa minkä jo tein ja hyvitystä ei myönnetty. En pysty suosittelemaan, sinne meni rahat turhaan ja maku koko sovellukseen sen vuoksi.

reviews.title: Ei rahojesi arvoinen
reviews.text: Ohjelmassa suloisen sekaisin ruotsin, suomen ja englannin kieltä. Haku ei löydä mitään, esim kun kirjoitin lohisalaatti, niin ehdotti mm. Hanaolutta?

reviews.title: Très décevant
reviews.text:
J’ai téléchargé l’appli et payé la version payant pour 1 an. Et ce il y a 1,5 mois et je me suis déjà détournée de l’appli. 
La courbe de perte de poids est trop idéalisée voir dangereuse. Malgré la version payant je trouve que l’appli n’est pas assez personnalisée. 
Concernant la fonctionnalité, le scan photo et pas mal mais les proportions pèchent !! Rien à voir avec la réalité ! Pourquoi ne pas demander en premier une photo du un truc qu’on a toujours sur soi comme un doigt, à côté du règle pour que l’IA puisse avoir l’échelle de l’assiette et mieux analyser les quantités ? De plus, au moins une fois par semaine, la fonctionnalité est HS.. écran noir … je dois prendre une photo avec mon tel puis l’ajouter dans l’appli … étrange 
Quand je démarre un repas, si je ne quitte pas la page, je perds tout … dommage de ne pas sauvegarder tout ce qu’on rentre ! Ça serait cool aussi de pouvoir partager des recettes au sein du foyer ! J’ai voulu le faire avec mon conjoint, déjà le parrainage n’a pas fonctionné mais en plus nous n’avons pas les mêmes données ! À croire que la version Android est plus abouti que la version Apple ! Et à quoi sert la plante franchement ? Rien n’es challengeant, je ne perd jamais mes séries même si je ne remplis rien … j’ai fait déjà plusieurs réclamations mais aucun retour … 
En bref, une bonne idée, de bonnes bases mais qui ressemble plus à une bêta test qu’à une appli / abonnement qui vaut le coup d’être payée !

reviews.title: Great idea, bugs ruin user experience
reviews.text: Used it for 5 days and a lot of food i logg into the app just disappears, so i have no real statistics

reviews.title: Virheitä
reviews.text: Latasin ja alussa toimi kivasti. Hyvää on ruokavalintojen kommentointi ja lukuisat motivoivat ohjeet. Mutta sovellus kadottaa jatkuvasti jo tehtyjä kirjauksia eli ne katoavat mystisesti. Joudun ottamaan kuvakaappauksia aina kirjausten jälkeen, koska ne pitää kirjata uudelleen. Tähän hintaan toivoisin virheetöntä toimintaa!

reviews.text: Keeps losing recorded data, for two days now. Apparently after latest update. Not possible to request support from the application. Annoying.
